$Comment: Ice King, phase 1 once the fight started: AT_Ice_King (same CAE_AT_Ice_King) but hostile for good, so he does not calm down and wander off ('?' Search) when the player stops hitting. AT_Ice_King_Encounter switches to it on the first hit (ChangeTargetRole). Without an encounter the neutral AT_Ice_King fights on its own. 2026-10-21: AlertedAnimation PhaseChange, so the start of this phase plays the phase-change animation (he passes through Alerted after every role change). 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): VO_Alert when he enters the role. 2026-10-22 (playtest: phase 1 fights like a mage; he walked into melee and mostly punched): he keeps 10-14 blocks (DesiredAttackDistanceRange, was 6-10) and flees to a safe distance when the target stays within 5 (CombatFleeIfTooCloseDistance, Component_Instruction_Combat_Retreat; was 2); AttackDistance and CombatBehaviorDistance 18, TargetRange 20 (were 12/12/12), so he engages from casting range. Phase 3 (Fridjitzu) stays a close fighter.
